name: Reggaeton Beach Party
description: Embrace the summer heat with a lively beach party at Praia da Baía. This one-day festival brings the best of reggaeton music to the coast for an unforgettable Saturday by the sea.
longDescription:
The Reggaeton Beach Party is a one-day music festival scheduled for Saturday, August 8, 2026. This event focuses on reggaeton music, presenting a selection of artists and DJs within the genre. It is organized as a summer celebration, taking place on the coast of Porto.

Attendees can expect an outdoor atmosphere at the Green Coast Beach Bar, situated on Praia da Baía. The event is designed for an adult audience interested in contemporary Latin music and a beach setting. The duration of the party is a full day, extending into the evening.

Admission to the Reggaeton Beach Party is ticketed. Specific details regarding ticket availability or purchase locations are not provided. The Green Coast Beach Bar is located on Praia da Baía, accessible via local transport routes to the coastal area.
